FAQ

We are camera-shy, how will the shoot feel?

We never force stiff poses. We direct natural interactions, laughter, and movements to ensure you feel 100% comfortable.

When should we plan our pre-wedding shoot?

Ideally 1 to 3 months before the wedding to allow time for editing and invitation use.
